flags: COMPOSITION: groups = the 73 v1 flowchart.json nodes carried over UNCHANGED (band + track added, nothing removed). 12 theory nodes -> band 'ground', 8 ground_exam nodes -> band 'exams', 19 sim nodes -> band 'fs', 26 flight + 8 checkride nodes -> band 'flights'. The fs/flights nodes act as the parent Training Sections of the sorties.

SORTIE->GROUP matching was NOT done by parsing the section label range: it uses the explicit v1 node field 'sorties' (e.g. I4601-03 lists ["I4601","I4602","I4603"]), then verifies that the v2 'section' label of each sortie maps to the same group. Every one of the 133 sorties landed inside exactly one v1 group and every v1 fs/flights group got exactly its v1 sorties_total sorties.
SORTIE COUNT reconciles with the syllabus totals: 48 F/S + 85 flights = 133 unique sorties, against PART III general programme 48/61,6 F/S and PART IV general programme 85/102,5 flights.

DUPLICATE SORTIE RECORDS across the 4 files: C5201, C2501 and C2502 are digitised twice — once in contact.json (their own category) and once in formation.json (reprinted inside the Formation chart, PDF p.17). Merged into one record each, keeping the contact.json reading as canonical and recording the Formation printing under 'also_printed_in'. All flags (night/checkride/first_solo/solo_candidate) and the band agree between the two files.

SECTION-LABEL MISMATCH (recorded, not corrected): formation.json labels C2501 and C2502 with section 'C2501', contact.json labels the same two sorties 'C25XX'. Both trace to v1 group C2501-03; the v1 node keeps the printed anomaly verbatim ('TRAINING SECTION: C2501 SORTIES/HOURS TOTAL: 3/3,9', PDF p.148). Each sortie keeps its own 'section_verbatim' per source file.

HOURS PER SORTIE are filled in ONLY where the syllabus makes them unambiguous: (a) 13 sorties whose Training Section holds exactly one sortie (C1101, C2101, I3601, N2101, C4101, C4590, C5090, C5490, I4490, I4701, I4890, F4690, N4690) take the printed hours_per_sortie; (b) C4790 = 0,8 h and C4791 = 0,3 h from the explicit 'DUAL SORTIES/HOURS: 1/0.8 SOLO SORTIES/HOURS: 1/0.3' split of section C4790-91, where the SOLO sortie is identified by name. All other 118 sorties carry hours=null — dividing a section total by its sortie count would be an invention. Every non-null value carries 'hours_basis'.

SECTIONS WITH A SOLO ALLOTMENT BUT MORE THAN ONE GREEN BOX therefore get no per-sortie hours: C4801-04 (1 solo, candidates C4802/C4803), C4901-05 (1 solo, candidates C4902/C4903/C4904), C5201-04 (1 solo, C5202/C5203), C5301-04 (1 solo, C5302/C5303), F4301-06 (2 solo, 5 candidates), F4501-03 (1 solo, F4501/F4502). The green frame means 'may be flown SOLO', not 'is SOLO'.

SOLO / NIGHT / CHECKRIDE CROSS-CHECK v1 <-> v2 passes with zero discrepancies: the 17 green boxes read from the chart (10 Contact + 7 Formation) are exactly the v1 solo_candidate_sorties; the 2 night sorties (I3601, I4701) are exactly the v1 night nodes; the 8 checkride sorties (C4590, C4790, C5090, C5490, I4490, I4890, F4690, N4690) are exactly the 8 v1 checkride nodes. C4791 stays first_solo (green frame), NOT a checkride — see the contact.json flag.

EDGES = the union of the four 'edges' arrays (58+35+30+32 = 155 raw) de-duplicated on (from,to,kind) -> 154, plus the 20 ground_entry_points rendered as edges with kind 'ground_entry' = 174 edges. kind / style / source / verbatim / note / printed_box / redundant_with_printed / expansion_rule are carried through untouched; 'origin' names the file(s) an edge came from.

ONE EDGE IS PRINTED TWICE ACROSS FILES: C2501 -> C2502 (sequence, solid) is drawn on the Contact page PDF p.12 and again on the Formation page PDF p.17. Merged into a single edge with pages_pdf [12,17] and duplicate_in_sources=true.

DELIBERATE SAME-PAIR DUPLICATES KEPT (different kind = independent evidence, flagged by the source files): C4790->C4791 (sequence + before), I4701->I4603 (sequence + before), I3601->I4701 (feed + prereq). Each such edge carries 'same_pair_kinds'. A renderer that only draws arrows must de-duplicate on (from,to).

GROUND-LESSON EDGE ENDPOINTS were normalised to v1 group ids, never to new nodes: 'PR 113' -> GT-INITIAL (printed box 'PR 101-113'), 'CR 202' -> GT-AERO-CRM (printed box 'CR 201-202*'), 'CO 190' -> CO190, 'NA190' -> NA190, 'LNAV790' -> LNAV790, 'GPS' -> GT-IFRNAV-GPS, 'CO 109' -> GT-CO109 etc. The original string is preserved in 'from_raw' / 'to_raw' / 'from_printed'.

REDUNDANT PREREQ vs GROUND_ENTRY pairs kept side by side (same from,to, different kind): CO190->C1101, GT-INITIAL->B1001, GT-AERO-CRM->C4101, NA190->N2101, LNAV790->N2201, FO190->F3101. The RESTRICTIONS text and the printed arrow are separate evidence; 'same_pair_kinds' marks them.

GROUND-TO-GROUND printed arrows (contact.json 'ground_chain' 19 + instrument.json 'ground_links' 7) are NOT in 'edges' — the requested schema scopes 'edges' to the four edge arrays plus ground_entry_points. They are kept lossless in the extra array 'ground_chain_edges' (9 edges after mapping). 17 of the 26 collapse into a self-loop because both boxes sit inside the same v1 theory group (e.g. OP 101-115 -> IC 101, both GT-INITIAL) and were dropped; they are listed in 'dropped_ground_selfloops'.
'ground_chain_edges' includes the one sortie->ground arrow of the whole chart: I4501 -> GT-CO109 (printed box 'CO 109'), dashed, leaving PDF p.15 and terminating on p.16.

The 98 v1 group-level edges are preserved verbatim in 'group_edges_v1' (43 sequence + 44 prereq + 11 implied). They are NOT merged into 'edges': 'edges' is sortie-level. The 11 v1 'implied' edges have no printed arrow at all (the F/S columns are drawn as disconnected groups in all four categories) and must not be mistaken for chart arrows.

OPEN SOURCE CONFLICTS carried over from the four files, none silently resolved: (a) Formation — the chart draws F3102 -> C5201 while PART III F31XX RESTRICTIONS says C5201 precedes the section; both edges are present (F3102->C5201 feed, C5201->F3101 prereq). (b) VFR Navigation — N44XX is 'LOW LEVEL' in the PDF 223 table but 'Medium Level' in its PART IV header, so C5201 -> N4401/N4402/N4403 were deliberately NOT created; if the table wins, three prereq edges must be added. (c) Instrument — v1 group I4101-02 has hours_total=null because the PART IV header prints '3 / 3.9' against 2 drawn boxes, so I4101/I4102 also carry hours=null. (d) Formation — the PART IV mission table prints the final checkride as 'F4790'; the chart, the section page and General Directives d. all give F4690, which is what is used. (e) Instrument — the I4502 -> I4601 page-break connector is solid on p.15 and dashed on p.16; recorded as solid after the originating stub.

PRINTED-STYLE ANOMALIES kept as data, not normalised: I3601 is band 'fs' but is drawn in the ground column of PDF p.16 with a thin ground border; C5201 / C2501 / C2502 / C4791 / F4401 are drawn as dashed cross-category reference boxes on foreign pages — those appearances are listed per sortie in 'also_printed_in' and the sortie keeps the band/track of its real Training Section.

FIELD PARITY across the four sources is still uneven and was NOT invented: contact.json carries no 'column' and no 'box_style', so its 54 sorties have neither; formation.json uses the box_style vocabulary double_thin / bold_single / dashed_double / green_double / orange_fill while instrument.json and vfr_navigation.json use double_outline_black / thick_solid_black / orange_fill_black_border / thin_solid_black. Only 'column' was already harmonised (center/right) upstream.
'totals', 'legend' and 'phases' are copied from v1 unchanged. 'source_flags' holds all 64 flags of the four v2 files plus the 13 v1 flags verbatim, so nothing recorded by the digitisers is lost.

ID-NAMESPACE OVERLAP (structural, NOT corrected): 13 ids exist BOTH as a group and as a sortie — C1101, C2101, C4101, C4590, C5090, C5490, F4690, I3601, I4490, I4701, I4890, N2101, N4690. This is inherent: v1 names a Training Section node after its only sortie whenever the section holds exactly one sortie, so group 'C4590' and sortie 'C4590' are the same training event at two granularities. Renaming either side would silently diverge from v1, so both keep their printed id and every group and sortie additionally carries a namespaced 'uid' ('g:C4590' / 's:C4590'), which IS unique across the file (206 uids, 0 duplicates). Every edge carries 'from_ref' / 'to_ref' with the resolved uid: on a shared id the SORTIE wins, because all four v2 files draw their edges at sortie level and every ground/exam endpoint exists only as a group.

VALIDATION RUN (independent re-read of the written file): JSON parses; 206 uids unique; every one of the 133 sorties falls inside the code range expanded from its group LABEL (e.g. I4601 in I4601-03, C4791 in C4790-91, F3102 in F3101-2) AND inside that group's v1 sorties[] array; every fs/flights group holds exactly its v1 sorties[] and matches its printed sorties_total; all 174 edge endpoints plus the 9 ground_chain_edges resolve to an existing sortie or group; edges unique on (from,to,kind); band/track/name of every sortie inherited from its group; the 73 v1 nodes are byte-identical to flowchart.json apart from the added band/track/uid.

The remaining six carry NO edge - none of them expresses an order or prerequisite relation between sorties, so no edge is missing: (1) C4101 is not graded in General performance (NG), except for Air Sickness, when SP performance is graded FAIR (59%), no FCJ is flown and training continues at the next block; (2) up to the PRE-SOLO phase max one A/C and one F/S sortie daily, apart from a mission aborted after becoming airborne due to adverse weather or A/C malfunction (MIC); (5) the C4790 evaluator supervises and grades SP's landing from the Contact Car; (6) nose-high unusual attitude recovery is initially taught as a pre-planned maneuver, and only after the SP achieves MIF "1" are recoveries practised from different attitudes without previous planning; (7) if the MINIMUM NUMBER of maneuvers is not achieved at the end of the block, it must be annotated in the grade sheet and executed at the next block; (8) ELPs are performed daytime and under VMC conditions only.

Field "diagram_level" is the vertical row index of the printed chart: boxes drawn at the same height share a level. The full level map, including the ground boxes and the dashed cross-reference box C 4791 (level 3), is in "diagram_levels"; within a level the entries are listed left to right: ground/cross-ref column, centre flight column, right F/S column.

Field "box_style" records the PRINTED border/fill measured from the raster, using the same vocabulary as vfr_navigation.json: "thick_solid_black" = 2.38-2.50 pt single border (F/S), "double_outline_black" = two ~0.9-1.0 pt concentric borders 1.44 pt apart (flight), "orange_fill_black_border" = the check rides I 4490 / I 4890, plus "thin_solid_black" = 1.00 pt single border, used only by I 3601 and matching the ground/academic boxes. box_style is therefore NOT a restatement of "band": I 3601 is band "fs" but box_style "thin_solid_black", and I 4490 / I 4890 are band "flights" but box_style "orange_fill_black_border".

CAVEAT on the inherited value name "orange_fill_black_border": it is kept for parity with vfr_navigation.json, but it understates the printed border on BOTH files. Measured at 16x, I 4490 and I 4890 carry exactly the same DOUBLE outline as the plain flight boxes (two ~0.94 pt lines 1.44 pt apart on each edge) with fill RGB(255,192,0) added, not a single border; the same 4-line construction was measured on N 4690 at PDF p.19 (y 682.12 / 683.56 and 701.81 / 703.25), the box that vfr_navigation.json labels with this value.
